title: feat: comprehensive filter optimization — multi-select support and full field type coverage
body: Filter value inputs for reference fields (e.g. "所属客户") required manual ID entry instead of showing a dropdown. Select fields lacked multi-select when using `in`/`notIn` operators. Many field types (currency, datetime, time, status, user, owner) were treated as plain text in filter controls. ### FilterBuilder (`packages/components/src/custom/filter-builder.tsx`) - `FilterCondition.value` type widened to `string | number | boolean | (string | number | boolean)[]` - `in`/`notIn` operators on fields with `options` now render a checkbox list instead of a text input - Field types grouped into unified categories with proper operator sets and input types: - **numberLikeTypes** (`number`, `currency`, `percent`, `rating`) → number operators, number input - **dateLikeTypes** (`date`, `datetime`, `time`) → date operators, `date`/`datetime-local`/`time` input - **selectLikeTypes** (`select`, `status`) → select operators, dropdown or checkbox list - **lookupLikeTypes** (`lookup`, `master_detail`, `user`, `owner`) → lookup operators, dropdown or checkbox list - Extracted `normalizeToArray()` helper for consistent value → array coercion ```tsx // Before: lookup field rendered a plain — user typed raw IDs // After: lookup field with options renders
